==Days of the week==
===Numeric system===
Rafsi are based on numeric rafsi. Starts with 1=Monday, or 0=Sunday. Advantages include compatibility with some languages (e.g. Chinese, Russian) and ISO numbering. Disadvantages include clashing with numbering in other languages (e.g. Portuguese, Greek)
{| class="wikitable"
! English !! Lojban !! Etymology
|-
| Monday || {{jvs|pavdei}} || '''pa''' (one)
|-
| Tuesday || {{jvs|reldei}} || '''re''' (two)
|-
| Wednesday || {{jvs|cibdei}} || '''ci''' (three)
|-
| Thursday || {{jvs|vondei}} || '''vo''' (four)
|-
| Friday || {{jvs|mumdei}} || '''mu''' (five)
|-
| Saturday || {{jvs|xavdei}} || '''xa''' (six)
|-
| Sunday || {{jvs|zeldei}} / {{jvs|nondei}} || '''ze''' (seven) / '''no''' (zero)
|}

===Spectral / rainbow system===
Rafsi based on the primary and secondary colors of the visible light spectrum. This system is novel; an advantage is that purple can also result from a mixture of blue and red, thus reflecting the cyclic nature of the week.
{| class="wikitable"
! English !! Lojban !! Etymology
|-
| Sunday || {{jvs|xundei}} || {{jvs|xunre}} (red)
|-
| Monday || {{jvs|najdei}} || {{jvs|narju}} (orange)
|-
| Tuesday || {{jvs|peldei}} || {{jvs|pelxu}} (yellow)
|-
| Wednesday || {{jvs|ri'odje}} / '''ri'ordei''' || {{jvs|crino}} (green)
|-
| Thursday || {{jvs|cicnydei}} || {{jvs|cicna}} (cyan)
|-
| Friday || {{jvs|bladei}} || {{jvs|blanu}} (blue)
|-
| Saturday || {{jvs|zirdei}} || {{jvs|zirpu}} (purple)
|}

===Elemental system===
Rafsi based on historic alchemical/celestial associations. The planetary associations with the days are Western, the elemental associations with the planets are Eastern. The end result is reflected in languages like Japanese and Vietnamese.

{| class="wikitable"
! English !! Lojban !! Etymology
|-
| Sunday || {{jvs|soldei}} || {{jvs|solri}} (Sun)
|-
| Monday || {{jvs|lurdei}} || {{jvs|lunra}} (Moon)
|-
| Tuesday || {{jvs|fagdei}} || {{jvs|fagri}} (fire, associated with Mars)
|-
| Wednesday || {{jvs|jaudje}} / '''jaurdei''' || {{jvs|djacu}} (water, associated with Mercury)
|-
| Thursday || {{jvs|mudydei}} || {{jvs|mudri}} (wood, associated with Jupiter)
|-
| Friday || {{jvs|jimdei}} || {{jvs|jinme}} (metal, associated with Venus)
|-
| Saturday || {{jvs|derdei}} || {{jvs|dertu}} (earth/dirt, associated with Saturn)
|}
